messages.author: 6e3dd74b422c061b
messages.subject: von Mises model is parsed but fails to compile
parts:
Dear Stan team,

the attached model is parsed without errors or warnings with rstan 2.11.1 but fails to compile using Rtools 3.3 and R 3.3.1.

I can't understand what the compiler is printing out, but I am sure you do. Many thanks for your help!

All the best,
Paul

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] von Mises model is parsed but fails to compile
parts:
I verified that it's indeed a problem with the 2.11 release
and has indeed been fixed for 2.12 already. We need to
get the 2.12 release out because there are a few outstanding
bugs that we've patched. I was hoping we'd get compound
declare-and-define and also vectorization into 2.12, but maybe
we should release before that?

- Bob
